title: Set compensation bands and review pay
summary: When hiring levels, roles or locations require a consistent compensation framework. An approved role-and-location pay framework with documented exceptions and an owned review cycle.
outcomes: An approved role-and-location pay framework with documented exceptions and an owned review cycle.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: When hiring levels, roles or locations require a consistent compensation framework.

parts.title: Inventory roles and current compensation
parts.guidance: Collect role scope, level, work location, employment arrangement and current cash and equity terms in a restricted workspace. Normalize hours and currencies and separate guaranteed pay from variable or contingent awards.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Build a documented comparison and cost model
parts.guidance: Compare relevant market evidence and internal role scope, and model payroll cost and affordability. Record source dates, sample limits and exchange assumptions instead of treating a vendor estimate as a required rate.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Review fairness and applicable local constraints
parts.guidance: HR, finance and advisers assess pay equity, local minimums, disclosure duties and contractual constraints. Investigate unexplained differences and distinguish a performance assessment from a protected personal characteristic.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Review fairness and applicable local constraints

parts.title: Approve bands and individual exceptions
parts.guidance: Leadership approves the framework, budget, exception authority and review cadence. Obtain appropriate approvals before offering, changing or promising compensation or equity to a person.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

parts.title: Record changes and monitor the framework
parts.guidance: Reconcile approved changes with contracts, payroll and grant processes. Communicate only the authorized individual terms and track exceptions, hiring feedback and the next review.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

verify.how: An approved role-and-location pay framework with documented exceptions and an owned review cycle.

notes.text: This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. Qualified advisers own legal, tax, safety or regulatory determinations and any required professional work. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.
Editorial status: operational draft. Source pages checked on 2026-10-29. No case-specific legal review, professional assurance or completed execution is claimed.
